exclusions: Fungi are not plants; do not describe them as photosynthetic or rooted botanical organisms.
Do not attribute plans, altruism, or supernatural intelligence to fungal networks.
Identify lichen as a symbiosis and slime molds as fungus-adjacent protists rather than true fungi.
Do not turn toxic or psychoactive species into foraging, dosing, or medical instructions.
prompt_context: Fungi are not plants. Build each episode around one named subject, observable structure, habitat interval, biological mechanism, and evidence method. Distinguish fungal fruiting bodies from the larger mycelial organism, identify symbioses and fungus-adjacent organisms accurately, and keep toxicity or health claims non-instructional.
